## AmplifAI Overview

Every customer interaction creates data. Where that data lands, who sees it, and what happens next shapes coaching sessions, QA scores, and the decisions CX leadership makes.

AmplifAI brings it all together unifying every data source, structured and unstructured, across voice, chat, email, social, CRM, workforce management, and conversational intelligence into a single view of performance. From there, AmplifAI delivers role-specific insights and AI-powered recommended actions to every level of your contact center, from frontline agents and team leaders to quality analysts, operations directors, and CX leadership.

Customer analytics, automated QA, coaching, performance management, CX intelligence, and recognition in one platform built for the complexity of enterprise contact centers and global BPOs.

With AmplifAI new agents learn what top performers do differently. Team leaders know exactly who to coach and on what. Quality and Compliance teams catch patterns across 100% of interactions. CX leaders see the full customer journey.

AmplifAI is used by over 10,000 teams in enterprises and BPOs across financial services, healthcare, retail, communications, and technology, with contact centers ranging from hundreds to tens of thousands of agents across multiple geographies.

Over 10,000 teams use AmplifAI to drive measurable improvement in agent performance, coaching effectiveness, customer satisfaction, and retention.
